requirements.text: The bidder must be registered with the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) in category C-A or C-1 with relevant specialization.
The bidder must have completed at least three road construction contracts each valued at not less than PKR 700 million.
The bidder must have completed at least one bridge structure of span 60 metres or greater as prime contractor.
The bidder must have an average annual construction turnover of at least PKR 1,500 million over the last three audited financial years supported by audited financial statements.
The bidder must provide bid security of PKR 37 million (2%) in the form of a CDR or bank guarantee.
The bidder must own or have assured access to a batching plant, asphalt plant and crusher within 50 km of the project corridor.
The bidder must have valid ISO 14001 environmental management certification for works within the protected watershed zone.
The bidder should submit a detailed construction methodology covering earthworks, pavement layers, structures and traffic management.
The bidder should provide a CPM-based work program demonstrating completion within 24 months including monsoon constraints.
Key staff shall include a Project Manager (PEC-registered professional engineer with 15+ years’ experience) and a Bridge Engineer (with 10+ years’ experience).
The bidder should describe its HSE management system, and a documented zero-fatality record over the last five years is preferred.
The bidder should propose a quality control plan with on-site laboratory facilities for soils, aggregates, concrete and asphalt testing.
Bids shall be submitted to the Office of the Superintending Engineer, C&W, Circle, Peshawar in sealed envelopes under the single stage one envelope procedure as per KPPRA Rules 2014.
